description: the woman of the reference picture riding: a slim reaper lady in a deep black hood of smoke, a few strands of dark red-brown hair, the face hidden behind a silver mask shaped like a skull with glowing crimson eyes, black armour with white bone plates shaped like ribs on the chest, spiked bone pauldrons, a dark belt, a long tattered black cloak hanging behind from the shoulders and covering the far side of the body, one black boot with a pale bone knee guard on the near leg only, no spirit lights, no scythes and nothing in the hands but the reins; sitting tall and upright astride a saddle that is not drawn, the back straight, not squatting and not crouching, seen exactly from the side in a strict profile, facing right, the head, chest and hips turned fully to the right; both forearms reaching forward, the two hands together in front of the body holding short reins that end just in front of the hands; only the near leg showing and only one foot in the whole picture: the thigh lying forward and level from the hip to the knee, the knee bent at a right angle, the lower leg hanging vertically straight down from the knee, one whole foot at the bottom with the toes pointing right; the cloak and any long hair hanging down behind the back, not spread out; the far leg completely hidden and not drawn at all, no second boot and no second foot; the whole figure from the top of the hood to the sole of the foot inside the picture with room around it; nothing under the rider; isolated figure on a plain background

references.usage: the character's look: this same woman, her skull mask, smoke hood, hair, bone armour, cloak and colours, drawn the same way; not her standing pose and not her legs, not the two scythes and not the spirit lights
